title: Canonical strict point-system inverse image and whole-tower sections
statement: Let $D$ be the finite-field datum, with algebraically closed geometric field $k$ and geometric Frobenius $h:\operatorname{Spec}k\to\operatorname{Spec}k$, and let $\ell$ be prime and $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ finite with valuation ring $R$ and fixed uniformizer $\varpi$ [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], [def-trf-scheme-frobenius]. Put $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. The site universe $t$ and coefficient universe $u$ are independent; scalar rings and modules use the common lift to $\max(u,t+1)$. For $n\in\mathbf N$ put $B_n=(R/\varpi^{n+1})_s$. Use the ringed sequence site $\mathbf N\times s_{\mathrm{proet}}$, its vertical-cover topology, sequence coefficient sheaf $B_\bullet$, category $\mathcal S$ of strict $B_\bullet$-module systems, and completed scalar restriction $U:\mathcal S\to\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(\widehat R_s))$ retaining every original quotient-linear transition [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site]. For every $r\in\mathbf N$, define $h^0=\mathrm{id}$ and $h^{r+1}=h\circ h^r$. Define the site reindexing $\rho_r(n,(V\xrightarrow v s))=(n,(V\xrightarrow{h^rv}s))$, identity on coefficient indices and underlying site arrows. Let $\mathrm{sequenceRing}$ be $B_\bullet$ with commutativity forgotten. Let $c_{r,n}:(h^r)^{-1}B_n\to B_n$ be the canonical coefficient isomorphism [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. Define $\mathrm{coefficient}_r:B_\bullet\to\rho_{r,*}B_\bullet$ by the uniquely specified components $c_{r,n}^{-1}$ on every site object. Define $G_r:\mathcal S\to\mathcal S$ as sectionwise reindexing along $\rho_r$ with scalar action restricted through $\mathrm{coefficient}_r$; explicitly $(G_rM)_n(V,v)=M_n(V,h^rv)$ and horizontal transitions are the original reindexed transitions. Let $T=\Gamma_{\mathrm{none}}:\operatorname{Mod}(\widehat R_s)\to\operatorname{Mod}(R)$ be point sections with constant integral scalar action [def-trf-point-restriction-coordinates]. Define $\Gamma_\bullet=\operatorname{Tow}(T)\circ U:\mathcal S\to\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(R))$, including all original transitions, and $\mathrm{complexSections}$ by applying $\Gamma_\bullet$ termwise to unbounded cochain complexes. Equip whole $R$-module towers with their standard unbounded derived localization [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], denoted $\mathrm{towerDerived}$, and let $\mathrm{derivedSections}:D(\mathcal S)\to D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(R)))$ be the termwise sections functor descended through quasi-isomorphisms. These definitions contain no choice of a transport transformation, no derived inverse limit, and no boundedness, constructibility, normalization or completeness condition on a system; they also include $r=0$ and do not require $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k$.
